english.note: For an attributed quotation, 引用 is the all-purpose choice in formal or written contexts; it does not mean quotation marks or a price estimate.

exampleSentences.english: The quote in the report is from Lu Xun.
exampleSentences.traditional: 報告入面嗰段引用係出自魯迅嘅。
